selectionReason: Clean master exactly matches startCommit; D-304 authorizes implementation, findings are empty and B1 review is not due before I01-I04. I01f1b is the earliest eligible child after implemented I01f1a. No priority is skipped or parent obligation narrowed.

coverage: The normal APK is org.asyncttwiz.android with production MainActivity, minSdk29/target36 and real off-main no-backup storage open. I01f1b1 observes the ordinary branded scaffold and checks actual installed APK/package/signer/API plus read-only storage startup; it adds no alternate launcher, dummy button, injected account/game records or production failure hook. Screenshot/hierarchy must be actual device evidence, with large binaries kept private when appropriate and committed hashes/redacted check output retained.

I01f1b1 must bound install/launch/capture and failed startup evidence, regress the existing ownership/readiness/cleanup refusal and execute an actual owned API29 lifecycle. This is not an Appium driver session, Kotlin UI scenario or execution of the 14 storage instrumentation tests. I01f2 retains those obligations and ordinary failed migration/retry/recreation assertions; host SQLite or APK assembly cannot substitute for them.

I01f1b2 must measure actual Windows/WSL reachability and choose a working explicit public-only device route, not assume Windows ADB reverse reaches Linux loopback. Preserve the two existing public/source loopback port numbers and served art origins. Any required test-only loopback relay needs exact endpoint/process/start ownership and collision checks; no wildcard bind, private health/admin/reset/mailbox/DB/SMTP forward, global networking/hypervisor changes or production TLS relaxation.

The service-only controller currently requires empty forward/reverse mappings, so routing must extend rather than remove that invariant: record recoverable owned routes before mutation, no rebind/remove-all/adoption of foreign state, revalidate attached endpoints before combined success, invalidate stale combined handoff after failure and remove only exact owned mappings. Retain actual broken-route refusal then successful recovery. The normal backend currently expects public 404; source metadata/catalog/art bytes and hashes supply meaningful actual transport checks without an absent downloader/auth claim.

I01f1b2 repeats normal-APK startup with the real Compose instance ready, retains redacted route/startup/failure evidence before exact device/ADB/Appium/mapping/relay/Compose cleanup and proves unrelated inventory unchanged. Document reusable setup/wait/capture/unroute/cleanup plus endpoint-reset revalidation for I01f2. Fresh app data and Compose reset before independent scenarios remain distinct from retained in-scenario force-stop/relaunch; no silent reset or product action injection.

Parent I01f1b outcome/checks remain verbatim; completing children is not parent integration or B1 review. Concurrent two/three devices, cold-boot/reset repeats and per-device instrumentation stay I01f3. Account/deck/gameplay/Canvas acceptance remains later tasks. Physical frame measurement I33, current/tablet/mixed-version/signed upgrade/arm64 I35 and operator rights/signing/readiness gates remain unverified without waivers.
